submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Continue the existing Water Dragon Scholar EAST running animation with ONE new full-body production cel. Input1 is corrected frame01 and locks exact face/costume/head volume/proportions/camera; input2 is selected frame09, the opposite RIGHT landing phase, with correct near-right fan arm behind. Input3 original identity; input4 approved primary hand-painted style only, ignore UI.
One native square1254x1254 or at least1024 transparent RGBA, fixed orthographic EAST profile, face to screen RIGHT. Preserve navy straight hair bun, turquoise-gold hair jewel and blue tassels, blue/ivory/gold wave-cloud scholar robe, white trousers, blue-gold boots, ONE open ivory fan with blue water-dragon painting and black ribs.
ANATOMY LOCK: EAST near side is RIGHT. Near RIGHT shoulder/upper-arm/elbow/forearm connects visibly to RIGHT hand firmly gripping the fan's actual black pivot/handle. Near arm overlaps torso whenever in front. FAR LEFT arm is EMPTY and swings oppositely; where it goes behind, its upper arm is occluded by torso. Never move fan to far left hand. Fan is rigid with fingers wrapped around pivot, no detached fan/side-edge grip. Jade remains attached at far anatomical left hip; perspective can occlude it.
Frame 14/16, phase 13/16 of a full 480ms two-step run cycle: Second flight apex: BOTH boots at least 5% canvas above virtual floor. LEFT boot unfolds forward for touchdown, RIGHT knee bent heel behind. Hip/head 3% above contact. RIGHT fan arm at forward extreme, LEFT empty arm at rear extreme.
Keep same full canvas registration and global scale as inputs1/2. Virtual floor y1191 on 1254 canvas (95%); fixed root x627. Support soles touch that fixed invisible floor, but flight frames preserve stated air gap; do not resize/crop/recenter the body to fill each canvas. Head/hair size fixed, only rise/fall of actual articulated run phase. Feet/knees must clearly show the stipulated side-specific phase and oppose arm swing; no march, sliding lunge or static fan showcase. Robe/sleeves trail naturally and expose both short booted legs. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painted finish. Every frame individually drawn with genuinely changed shoulder/elbow/hip/knee/ankle articulation, not copied/warped/interpolated/mirrored. No shadow/ground/background/checkerboard/text/labels/FX/motion blur or multiple poses.
